title: 第3章 捡了个宗门第4章 捡了个老头
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落期待地看着手中的剑，她现在无处可去，在这危机四伏的森林里，太需要一个安全之所了。
诛邪剑和云星落心意相通，当然知道她的想法。
“自然是有的，不过我力量不够，请主人再给我几滴血，我把主人带到这个地方。”
剑灵早就惦记云星落的血了，和她掰扯了这么久，就是想要她的血。
“几滴血而已，给你。”
剑灵的需求，云星落当然满足。
她毫不犹豫拿起剑在指尖上一划，几滴鲜血瞬间渗入剑身之中。
吸收了这几滴带着本源力量的血，诛邪剑剑身光芒大作。
云星落只感觉到眼前一花，整个人已经从大树上离开，来到一个陌生的空间。
然而当看清眼前的景象时，云星落不由得倒吸一口凉气，这哪是什么空间，分明是被时光掩埋的人间炼狱？
只见眼前的空间一片死寂，四处都是尸体，由于年代久远，全部变成了白骨。
脚下的土地被血浸透染成了黑褐色，地面上散落着一把把早已生锈的武器。
所有建筑都看不出原本的样子，只剩下断壁残垣。
远处的山峦更是光秃秃的，没有一点生机，只有满目的死寂和荒芜。
“这是？”
“这是老主人原来的宗门，叫摘星宗，你落地的这棵大树就是宗门的入口。”
“十万年前，异族入侵，摘星宗位于异族和我们玄黄大陆入口附近，承担着抵挡异族入侵，维护天下和平的重任。”
“宗主楚星澜带着几万弟子，和异族人苦战三天，终于等来了玄黄大陆的高手。
但摘星宗十万弟子几乎全部战死，就连宗主，最后也战死在这片土地上。”
“楚星澜，你说的可是摘星大帝？”

云星落在江湖风云录这本书上看到过关于摘星大帝的介绍。
他本是一名散修，后来一个人建立起一个大宗门，弟子无数。
后来为了抵御异族，楚星澜苦战异族十大高手，最后拉着十大高手一起战死。
他战死的地方就是现在的黑雾森林。
黑雾森林在十万年前叫梦幻之森，和异族的那场大战之后，由于怨气太重，整个森林弥漫着一层淡淡的黑色雾气，后来世人就称这片森林为黑雾森林。
“原来是这样。”
云星落看着地上一具具白森森的尸骸，不由得肃然起敬。
“所以你能理解我为什么不想和你契约了吧，我当时就想找个天才，日后能恢复摘星宗的荣光。”
“理解。”
云星落点点头，这把剑也算是背负深仇大恨了。
诛邪剑哀伤地在遗迹上空转了几圈，还是找不到它心心念念的人，最后落在云星落面前。
“这里全是怨气，不能住人，麻烦主人帮我把这些白骨埋了，让他们入土为安，空气中的怨气自然就消散了。”
“这些前辈为了人类而战，为他们收拾尸骨，义不容辞。”
云星落弯腰开始收拾。
只是这些骸骨年代久远，轻轻一碰就化成了灰。
无奈云星落只能到树上折些树叶当作扫把，一点点把它们扫成堆。
尽管这样，漫山遍野的骨骸，还是需要收拾很久。
……
就在云星落收拾骨骸的时候，黑雾森林上空，电闪雷鸣，风起云涌。
content_en:
Yun Xingluo looked at the sword in her hand expectantly. She had nowhere to go now. She needed a safe place in this dangerous forest.
Zhu Xie Jian and Yun Xingluo had the same mind, so of course he knew what she was thinking.
"Of course there is, but I don't have enough strength. Please give me a few more drops of blood, master, and I will bring you to this place."
Sword Spirit has been thinking about Yun Xingluo's blood for a long time. He has been fighting with her for so long because he wants her blood.
"It's just a few drops of blood, here you go."
Yun Xingluo would certainly meet the needs of the sword spirit.
Without hesitation, she picked up the sword and drew it on her fingertips, and a few drops of blood seeped into the sword instantly.
After absorbing these drops of blood with the original power, the sword of the Evil Killing Sword glowed brightly.
Yun Xingluo only felt a flower in front of his eyes. He had left the big tree and came to a strange space.
However, when he saw the scene in front of him clearly, Yun Xingluo couldn't help but take a breath of cold air. What kind of space was this? It was clearly a human purgatory buried by time?
The space in front of him was completely silent, with corpses everywhere, all turned into white bones due to the passage of time.
The ground beneath his feet was soaked in blood and dyed dark brown, and there were rusty weapons scattered on the ground.
None of the buildings can be seen in their original appearance, only broken walls and ruins remain.
The mountains in the distance are even more bare, without any life, only full of death and desolation.
"This is it?"
"This is the old master's original sect, called the Star Reaching Sect. The big tree you landed on is the entrance to the sect."
"One hundred thousand years ago, the aliens invaded. The Star Reaching Sect was located near the entrance of the aliens and our Xuanhuang Continent. It shouldered the important task of resisting the invasion of aliens and maintaining peace in the world."
"The sect leader Chu Xinglan led tens of thousands of disciples and fought hard with the aliens for three days, and finally the masters from the Xuanhuang Continent arrived.
However, almost all the 100,000 disciples of the Star Reaching Sect died in the battle, and even the sect leader died on this land in the end. "
"Chu Xinglan, are you talking about the Star Reaching Emperor?"
I have read an introduction about the Star-Zhaing Emperor in the book Yunxingluo Jianghu Fengyunlu.
He was originally a casual cultivator, but later he established a large sect with countless disciples.
Later, in order to resist the alien race, Chu Xinglan fought hard against the top ten masters of the alien race, and finally led the top ten masters to fight together to death.
The place where he died in battle is now the Black Mist Forest.
The Black Mist Forest was called the Forest of Dreams 100,000 years ago. After the great war with the aliens, due to too much resentment, the entire forest was filled with a layer of faint black mist. Later, the world called this forest the Black Mist Forest.
"So that's it."
Yun Xingluo looked at the white corpses on the ground and couldn't help but stand in awe.
"So you can understand why I don't want to make a contract with you. I wanted to find a genius at that time who could restore the glory of the Star Reaching Sect in the future."
"Understood."
Yun Xingluo nodded, this sword could be regarded as bearing a great hatred.
Zhuxie Sword sadly circled over the ruins for several times, but still couldn't find the person it was longing for, and finally landed in front of Yun Xingluo.
"This place is full of resentment and cannot be inhabited. Master, please help me bury these bones and let them rest in peace. Then the resentment in the air will naturally dissipate."
"These seniors fought for humanity and it is their duty to collect their corpses."
Yun Xingluo bent down and started to clean up.
It's just that these bones are so old that they turn into ashes at the slightest touch.
Yun Xingluo had no choice but to go to the tree and break some leaves to use as a broom, sweeping them into piles bit by bit.
Despite this, the bones scattered all over the mountains and plains still need to be sorted out for a long time.
…
Just as Yun Xingluo was collecting the bones, lightning flashed, thunder and wind surged over the black mist forest.
